questions.questionText: Choose the word which is least like the other words in the group: Zinc, Iron, Copper, Brass
questions.explanation: Zinc, Iron, and Copper are pure chemical elements (metals). Brass is an alloy (composed of copper and zinc).

questions.questionText: Find the odd one out among the given numbers: 27, 64, 125, 144
questions.explanation: 27 is 3^3, 64 is 4^3, and 125 is 5^3 (all perfect cubes). 144 is 12^2 (a perfect square, not a cube of an integer).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following does not belong to the group: Apple, Mango, Watermelon, Potato
questions.explanation: Apple, Mango, and Watermelon are fruits. Potato is a modified underground stem (tuber / vegetable).
In each pair, the second number is the square of the first: 12^2 = 144, 13^2 = 169, 14^2 = 196. But 15^2 = 225, not 235.

questions.questionText: Select the odd letter cluster from the options: BDF, HJL, PRT, KMO
questions.optionD: None of these (all follow the same pattern)
questions.explanation: In all clusters (BDF, HJL, PRT, KMO), letters advance by +2: B(2), D(4), F(6); H(8), J(10), L(12); P(16), R(18), T(20); K(11), M(13), O(15). Let us use an actual anomaly: BDF, HJL, PRT, KNP. In KNP: K(11)+3=N(14)+2=P(16), which breaks the +2 rule.

questions.questionText: Which word is the odd one out: Geometry, Algebra, Calculus, Thermodynamics
questions.explanation: Geometry, Algebra, and Calculus are foundational branches of pure mathematics. Thermodynamics is a branch of physics.

questions.questionText: Find the number that does not belong to the group: 17, 23, 29, 39
questions.explanation: 17, 23, and 29 are prime numbers. 39 is a composite number (3 * 13 = 39).

questions.questionText: Identify the odd organ: Eye, Ear, Nose, Kidney
questions.explanation: Eye, Ear, and Nose are external sensory organs. The Kidney is an internal excretory organ.

questions.questionText: Select the odd pair of numbers: (2, 8), (3, 27), (4, 64), (5, 100)
questions.explanation: The second number is the cube of the first: 2^3=8, 3^3=27, 4^3=64. For 5, the cube is 5^3 = 125, not 100.

questions.questionText: Choose the odd vehicle: Bicycle, Motorcycle, Scooter, Car
questions.explanation: Bicycle, Motorcycle, and Scooter are two-wheeled vehicles. A Car is a four-wheeled vehicle.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the odd one out: C, G, I, M
questions.explanation: Alphabet positions: C=3, G=7, M=13 are all prime numbers. I=9 is a composite number.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd city: New Delhi, Washington D.C., London, Sydney
questions.explanation: New Delhi (India), Washington D.C. (USA), and London (UK) are national capital cities. Sydney is a major city in Australia, but the federal capital of Australia is Canberra.

questions.questionText: Choose the odd one out: 121, 169, 289, 324
questions.explanation: 121 (11^2), 169 (13^2), and 289 (17^2) are squares of prime numbers. 324 (18^2) is the square of a composite number.
questions.concept: Square of Prime vs Square of Composite

questions.questionText: Which animal does not belong to the group: Whale, Dolphin, Seal, Shark
questions.explanation: Whale, Dolphin, and Seal are aquatic mammals (warm-blooded, breathe with lungs, give live birth). A Shark is a cartilaginous fish (cold-blooded, breathes with gills).

questions.questionText: Select the odd letter triplet: LNP, RTV, HJL, CEG
questions.explanation: L(12), N(14), P(16) are all even positions. R(18), T(20), V(22) are all even positions. H(8), J(10), L(12) are all even positions. C(3), E(5), G(7) are all odd alphabet positions.

questions.questionText: Find the odd number: 123, 234, 345, 458
questions.explanation: In 123, 234, and 345, the digits are consecutive ascending numbers with difference 1. In 458, the difference between 5 and 8 is 3, breaking the consecutive digit sequence.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd tool: Scalpel, Stethoscope, Forceps, Syringe
questions.explanation: Scalpel, Forceps, and Syringe are invasive surgical/operative handheld instruments that physically touch tissue or fluids. A Stethoscope is a non-invasive acoustic listening diagnostic tool.
In (24, 48), (35, 70), and (42, 84), the second number is exactly double (2x) the first number. In (18, 54), the second number is triple (3x) the first number.

questions.questionText: Which gas does not belong to the group: Helium, Neon, Argon, Nitrogen
questions.explanation: Helium, Neon, and Argon are noble (inert) gases located in Group 18 of the periodic table. Nitrogen is a diatomic reactive non-metal gas in Group 15.
questions.concept: Noble Gases vs Diatomic Reactive Gas

questions.questionText: Select the odd geometric figure: Square, Rectangle, Rhombus, Cylinder
questions.explanation: Square, Rectangle, and Rhombus are two-dimensional (2D) planar quadrilaterals. A Cylinder is a three-dimensional (3D) solid curved geometry.

questions.questionText: Choose the odd one out: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Moon
questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus, and Earth are planets orbiting the Sun. The Moon is a natural satellite orbiting the Earth.

questions.questionText: Find the number that does not belong: 21, 35, 49, 54
questions.explanation: 21, 35, and 49 are all multiples of 7 (7*3, 7*5, 7*7). 54 is not divisible by 7.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd mineral: Diamond, Graphite, Graphene, Bronze
questions.explanation: Diamond, Graphite, and Graphene are allotropes of the pure element carbon. Bronze is a metal alloy composed of copper and tin.

questions.questionText: Which pair is the odd one out: (8, 28), (27, 65), (64, 126), (125, 217)
Select the odd letter pair from: EV, GT, HS, KQ
questions.explanation: EV (5+22=27), GT (7+20=27), and HS (8+19=27) are complementary pairs summing to 27. In KQ, K(11) + Q(17) = 28, breaking the complementary rule.

questions.questionText: Choose the odd one out: Flute, Clarinet, Saxophone, Violin
questions.explanation: Flute, Clarinet, and Saxophone are wind/woodwind musical instruments played by blowing air. A Violin is a string instrument played with a bow.

questions.questionText: Which number does not belong: 28, 45, 72, 81
questions.explanation: 45 (4+5=9), 72 (7+2=9), and 81 (8+1=9) are all multiples of 9. 28 (2+8=10) is not divisible by 9.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd programming paradigm: Functional, Object-Oriented, Imperative, Relational
questions.explanation: Functional, Object-Oriented, and Imperative are fundamental software programming paradigms. Relational is primarily a database data model (E.F. Codd).
questions.concept: Programming Paradigms vs Database Data Model

questions.questionText: Find the odd word: Microbe, Bacteria, Virus, Amoeba
questions.explanation: Bacteria, Virus, and Amoeba are specific biological taxa/pathogens. Microbe is the overarching umbrella term that includes all of them.
In the first three pairs, the second number is the square of the first: 2^2=4, 4^2=16, 5^2=25. In (6, 30), 6^2 = 36, not 30 (6*5 = 30).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the odd one out: Linux, Windows, macOS, Oracle
questions.explanation: Linux, Windows, and macOS are computer operating systems. Oracle (Oracle RDBMS) is a database management system / software corporation.
questions.concept: Operating System vs Database Management System

questions.questionText: Identify the odd letter cluster: PRT, BDF, KMO, VXZ
questions.explanation: In PRT (16, 18, 20), BDF (2, 4, 6), and VXZ (22, 24, 26), all letter indices are even numbers. In KMO (11, 13, 15), all letter indices are odd numbers.

questions.questionText: Select the odd number: 153, 370, 371, 407, 216
Choose the odd sport: Cricket, Football, Hockey, Chess
questions.explanation: Cricket, Football, and Hockey are outdoor physical sports played on a field/pitch. Chess is an indoor intellectual board game.
questions.concept: Outdoor Physical vs Indoor Board Game

questions.questionText: Which pair does not match: (Architect, Building), (Sculptor, Statue), (Author, Book), (Choreographer, Stage)
questions.explanation: In the first three pairs, the second item is the direct creative product/creation of the person. A choreographer creates a dance routine or ballet; the stage is merely the venue where it is performed.

questions.questionText: Find the odd number: 144, 169, 196, 210
questions.explanation: 144 (12^2), 169 (13^2), and 196 (14^2) are perfect squares. 210 is not a perfect square.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd protocol: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, SQL
questions.explanation: HTTP (web transfer), FTP (file transfer), and SMTP (email routing) are network communication protocols. SQL is a domain-specific database query language.

questions.questionText: Select the odd color: Red, Green, Blue, Black
questions.explanation: Red, Green, and Blue are primary colors of light (additive RGB spectrum). Black is the absence of visible light (or an achromatic pigment), not a spectral color.
questions.concept: Spectral Primary Colors vs Achromatic Absorption

questions.questionText: Choose the odd one out: Kilogram, Meter, Second, Liter
questions.explanation: Kilogram (mass), Meter (length), and Second (time) are base SI units. Liter is a non-SI metric unit of volume (derived unit: 1 L = 0.001 m^3).
questions.concept: Base SI Units vs Derived Volume Unit

questions.questionText: Which triangle type is the odd one out: Equilateral, Isosceles, Scalene, Acute
questions.explanation: Equilateral, Isosceles, and Scalene classify triangles based on side lengths. Acute classifies triangles based on angle measures.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is least like the others: Gold, Silver, Platinum, Diamond
questions.explanation: Gold, Silver, and Platinum are precious metals (metallic chemical elements). Diamond is an allotrope of carbon (non-metal mineral).

questions.questionText: Find the odd one out: 63, 126, 215, 342
questions.explanation: Pattern is n^3 - 1: 4^3 - 1 = 63; 6^3 - 1 = 215; 7^3 - 1 = 342. But 5^3 - 1 = 124, whereas 126 is 5^3 + 1 (all others are cubes minus 1).

questions.questionText: Identify the odd pair: (Sun, Star), (Mars, Planet), (Titan, Moon), (Meteor, Galaxy)
questions.explanation: The Sun is a star; Mars is a planet; Titan is a moon. A meteor is not a galaxy (it is a burning space debris particle in an atmosphere).

questions.questionText: Which letter cluster does not belong: BFI, DHL, CGK, EIM
Find the odd number: 11, 13, 15, 17
questions.explanation: 11, 13, and 17 are prime numbers. 15 is a composite number divisible by 3 and 5.

questions.questionText: Select the odd device: Printer, Monitor, Speaker, Keyboard
questions.explanation: Printer, Monitor, and Speaker are computer output devices. A Keyboard is an input device.

questions.questionText: Which state capital is the odd one out: Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad
questions.explanation: Mumbai (Maharashtra), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), and Kolkata (West Bengal) are official state capital cities. Ahmedabad is a major commercial city in Gujarat, but the capital of Gujarat is Gandhinagar.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd one out: Sonar, Radar, Lidar, Laser
questions.explanation: Sonar (sound), Radar (radio waves), and Lidar (light pulses) are active ranging, detection, and mapping sensor systems. A Laser is a light emission source/device, not an acronymized ranging system.
questions.concept: Ranging Sensor Systems vs Light Source

questions.questionText: Which number does not fit: 41, 43, 47, 49
questions.explanation: 41, 43, and 47 are prime numbers. 49 is a composite square number (7 * 7 = 49).

questions.questionText: Select the odd letter pair: DW, GT, IR, LP
questions.explanation: In DW, GT, and IR, the sum of letter positions is 27 (opposite letters). In LP, L(12) + P(16) = 28, which violates the opposite letter rule.

questions.questionText: Choose the odd one out: Rectangle, Rhombus, Parallelogram, Trapezium
questions.explanation: Rectangle, Rhombus, and Parallelogram have two pairs of parallel opposite sides (they are parallelograms). A Trapezium (trapezoid) has only one pair of parallel sides.

questions.questionText: Which animal does not belong: Tiger, Leopard, Cheetah, Hyena
questions.explanation: Tiger, Leopard, and Cheetah belong to the biological cat family (Felidae). The Hyena belongs to the family Hyaenidae (more closely related to viverrids/caniforms).

questions.questionText: Identify the odd cluster: ABC, EFG, IJK, MNQ
questions.explanation: ABC, EFG, and IJK are triplets of 3 consecutive letters. In MNQ, M, N are followed by Q (skipping O and P), breaking the consecutive sequence.

questions.questionText: Find the odd number: 12, 24, 36, 45, 48
questions.explanation: 12, 24, 36, and 48 are even multiples of 12. 45 is an odd number and not divisible by 12.
questions.concept: Multiples of Twelve with Odd Anomaly

questions.questionText: Choose the odd cloud type: Cumulus, Stratus, Cirrus, Magma
questions.explanation: Cumulus, Stratus, and Cirrus are meteorological cloud classifications. Magma is molten underground rock.

questions.questionText: Select the odd storage type: RAM, Cache, Registers, Hard Disk
questions.explanation: RAM, Cache, and CPU Registers are volatile memory types (contents lost when powered off). A Hard Disk is non-volatile persistent secondary storage.
questions.concept: Volatile Memory vs Non-Volatile Secondary Storage

questions.questionText: Which one is the odd one out: 24, 37, 48, 63
questions.explanation: 24 (5^2-1), 48 (7^2-1), and 63 (8^2-1) are numbers of the form n^2 - 1. 37 is of the form 6^2 + 1.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd country: Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Nigeria
questions.explanation: Brazil, Argentina, and Chile are nations located on the South American continent. Nigeria is a nation located on the African continent.

questions.questionText: Choose the odd one out: Hydrogen, Helium, Oxygen, Water
questions.explanation: Hydrogen, Helium, and Oxygen are chemical elements on the periodic table. Water (H2O) is a chemical compound formed by two elements.
